summary: Completed comprehensive testing of ME of Ukraine MedTrack application. Backend APIs are 100% functional. Desktop frontend working correctly. Critical mobile navigation issue found - Emergent badge overlay blocks user interactions.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile navigation buttons not clickable - 'Made with Emergent' badge overlay intercepts pointer events
ui_bugs.impact: Users cannot navigate between pages on mobile devices, making the app unusable on mobile
ui_bugs.attempted_fix: Increased z-index of .mobile-nav from 100 to 9999 in MobileNav.css, but requires frontend rebuild to take effect
ui_bugs.workaround: Use force=True in Playwright clicks, but this doesn't help real users

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix mobile navigation overlay issue. The 'Made with Emergent' badge is blocking clicks on mobile navigation buttons. Solution: Either (1) increase z-index of mobile-nav to 9999 and rebuild frontend, OR (2) reposition/hide the Emergent badge on mobile devices, OR (3) adjust badge z-index to be lower than navigation. The z-index fix has been applied to MobileNav.css but requires frontend rebuild (yarn build or restart) to take effect.
